post.caption:
Every living thing shares one ancestor, which is why every organism on Earth uses the same DNA code, the same cell machinery and the same energy currency. Fungi are more closely related to animals than to plants, and humans share roughly half their genes with a mushroom. The tree of life is not the shape most people picture.
